name: VQ-BeT / Behavior Transformer
summary: Behavior Transformer (2022) first showed a transformer with clustered action bins plus residual offsets could capture multimodal behavior. VQ-BeT replaces the clustering with hierarchical residual VQ-VAE action tokenization, giving a discrete latent action vocabulary a transformer predicts autoregressively then decodes to continuous actions, matching diffusion policy quality at several times faster inference.
innovation: Residual vector quantization of action chunks into a hierarchical discrete vocabulary.
Recovers multimodality in a single forward pass instead of an iterative denoising loop.
matters: Anticipated the learned-action-tokenizer direction that FAST later pushed into large VLAs.
limits: Quantization error caps precision, and the tokenizer must be retrained per action space.
lineage: Transformer policies with a learned discrete action codebook, as an alternative to diffusion.
